g.text: Three accounts, two services in use, and a security model that runs three gates deep
The storage you end up with
firewall + service endpoint · SAS from stored access policies · Entra ID RBAC
4.1 accounts — one per environment, redundancy chosen per environment
4.2 blob — containers, soft delete, versioning, the tier ladder
4.3 files — SMB shares mounted by Windows and Linux, snapshots
4.4 security — firewall, service endpoint, SAS policies, data-plane RBAC
what lives where, once the module is finished
